items.q: Who builds the eBuddha Digitech tools?
items.a: Our trainers and developers build them from the workflows we teach and use on client work in Bhopal.

items.q: Do I need an account to use a tool?
items.a: No. The free tools need no sign-up or login.
Yes. We add tools regularly. Tell us what you need on WhatsApp at +91 84619 58162.

items.q: Are the free tools really free?
items.a: Yes. You can use all 30 free tools for ads, social media, SEO, content and careers as often as you like.

items.q: Is my data saved when I use a tool?
items.a: Most tools run inside your browser and do not send your data to us. A few, such as the competitor analysis and broken link checker, fetch public pages through our server.

items.q: Which tool should I start with?
items.a: For SEO try the On-Page SEO Checker, for ads the Ad Budget & ROAS Calculator, and for social the 30-Day Content Planner.
They are an extra set of marketing tools you can unlock for ₹49 a month. Open Premium Tools on this page to see the list.

items.q: What are the tools from the course modules?
items.a: They are the third-party tools we teach in Modules 1 to 8. Each button opens the official website with a short how-to.

items.q: Can I learn to use these tools properly?
items.a: Yes. Our online digital marketing course teaches them on live projects.

items.q: Can your team run this marketing for my business?
items.a: Yes. See our Digital Marketing Services for SEO, ads, social media and websites.
